messages:
alex: Heads-up: I'm drafting a short runbook for the embeddings endpoint prebatching/contract changes. Goal: reduce 95p latency regressions when mixed-dim requests arrive. Want quick review before I post to the console rollout doc.
priya: thanks alex. can you call out the exact mismatch cases we care about? mixed dims, empty vectors, and huge single-array payloads?
alex: yup. specifically: 1) mixed dims in single request (we currently 413), 2) single huge-array that exceeds internal chunk budget (we drop or fail), 3) mis-declared dim header vs actual shape (silent truncation risk).
sam: for 2) do we have telemetry showing frequency? last week's 95p spikes looked correlated to a single tenant sending 1.2M floats in one POST.
morgan: i dug logs — about ~30 events last month hitting the payload size hard limiter during peak. most from two customers integrating vectorization client-side.
jules: idea: add a preflight-return with a lightweight checksum + suggested split points. user posts metadata, we reply: estimated tokens/chunks + recommended split. not blocking, just advisory.
alex: that matches the UX we discussed — preflight endpoint + console prompt that offers "auto-split" toggle. rollouts: start as opt-in for beta orgs.
priya: telemetry needs: count of preflight calls, preflight suggested splits accepted, actual rejections avoided, and post-split latency delta. Also surface top failure reasons (dim mismatch, too-large-chunk, malformed JSON).
sam: implement a short contract for preflight API: payload: {"dims": int, "count": int, "checksum": string (optional), "sample": base64?}. Response: {"ok": bool, "suggested_chunks": [int], "reason": string}. keep it tiny and cheap.
morgan: Ops question: rate-limit preflight differently than normal embed calls? otherwise customers can hammer preflight to probe quotas.
jules: agreed — quota group separate and much higher QPS but lower burst per-org; plus add sticky cooldown when we recommend split repeatedly.
alex: snippet I'll propose for the runbook (for devs/operators):
```
- Detect mixed-dim request -> auto-reject with 413 + preflight link.
- Detect oversized single-array -> return 200 with guidance and console CTA to auto-split.
- If "auto-split" accepted, enqueue split job and return streaming status updates via websocket/webhook.
```
priya: careful: auto-splitting changes billing semantics. we must log original item counts and resulting token units, and show them in console usage. clear consent checkbox required.
sam: for routing: if preflight shows many small chunks, route to high-throughput shard; if few large chunks prefer low-latency shard. We'll need a cost estimate field in preflight response.
morgan: for observability, panel suggestions: top 10 customers by preflight rejects, histogram of suggested chunk sizes, delta between preflight estimate and actual tokens processed. Add an alert when preflight_accept_rate < 50% for a major customer.
jules: rollout plan: alpha (internal) -> beta (10 customers) -> opt-in in console -> auto-enable after 2 weeks if error rates drop. add feature flag behind org-level toggle.
alex: good. last thing: add a checksum gate in preflight to detect payload corruption mid-transit. if checksum mismatches, reject with code 422 and link to docs.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: feature-branch/preflight-contract -> staging (ETA 2d).
priya: i'll write the short telemetry spec and update the console CTA copy: "We can split this payload for you to meet our size limits — enable auto-split?". Keep wording non-technical.
sam: i'll prototype the preflight response shape and a mock of the router heuristics.
alex: thanks all — i'll put the runbook in the eng-platform doc folder and ping infra for API review. posting a short follow-up later with exact schema and example payloads. :thumbsup:
